title: BlackBuck Q2 profit rises 42% to Rs 41 crore, revenue up 56%
summary: BlackBuck Q2 profit rises 42% to Rs 41 crore, revenue up 56%
detailed: The Bengaluru-based company’s revenue from operations grew 56% YoY to Rs 235 crore as compared to Rs 151 crore in the year-ago quarter.
